name: Blizzaga
doc: Blizzaga (the spell): the director - every 50 ticks the freeze of the next action on its first target: the target frozen from the bottom up, ribbons and spirals swirling round it, an ice block growing then breaking from the bottom into falling, spinning shards, a ring, a flash model, mist and flakes, the screen flash, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag104_blizzaga.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and model copies in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Freeze
parts.doc: One freeze an action on its first target: the target frozen from the bottom up, the ribbons and spirals, the ice block growing then breaking into falling shards, the ring, the flash model, mist and flakes, the screen flash, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the freeze
